name: InferHub Claude Code (LiteLLM)
purpose: Claude Code via local LiteLLM → InferHub seats; CKFF-cleared launcher

deploy_mirrors.label: Desktop claude-code launchers
deploy_mirrors.notes: Deploy FROM ACS after accepted merge. Desktop is mirror, not SoT.

title: Claude Code via InferHub + local LiteLLM

files.notes: Interactive model picker + seat apply + Claude Code start; loads secrets from Desktop configs\.env by path
Windows double-click entry that invokes the .ps1

secrets_policy.repo_rule: This module only stores sanitized launchers and docs. Secrets stay outside the repo. Scripts read keys by path; they must not embed values.

dependencies: Local LiteLLM workbench at D:\claude\litellm (repo Pukujan/litellm-ckff-ops)
Claude Code CLI available as `claude` on PATH
Desktop configs/.env providing LITELLM_MASTER_KEY or LITELLM_PROXY_KEY
summary: Pick a main and optional advisor model from the InferHub Top 20 list, apply seating aliases through the unified local LiteLLM proxy, clear CKFF/Anthropic env conflicts, then launch Claude Code against http://127.0.0.1:4000.
